ValidationRule.description: Prevents editing of Events with a status of "Cancelled"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISNEW()), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( NSP_Status__c ),"Cancelled"), NOT ($Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.EventValidations__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once the event is Cancelled, it cannot be modified.
